finalBrowserSessionReview.resourceInterpretation: Geometry/texture/program counts and current-node listener count remain constant. Broader DOM/listener/audio-handler counters include temporary and detached allocations and fall after GC; CDP heap falls to 17,844,848 bytes on Result. Sampled evidence does not show monotonic resource growth, and is not an unlimited-duration leak proof. Page performance.memory is coarse and remains 29.4MB, so it was not used alone to infer heap stability.
